phase1_leaf_result.part106_scope: Bounded official-GitHub audit of commit-status objects as a default service-side monotonic rollback witness coupled to Contents-API CAS publication.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: Commit statuses are separately created per commit SHA/context and listed newest-first, but the retrieved official docs provide no monotonic-ID/fencing guarantee, no atomic coupling to Contents CAS, no idempotency/expected-prior-status condition, and no GitHub.com guarantee of durable discoverability after the target commit becomes unreachable. Separate publication/status writes retain orphan, missing-witness and duplicate-status ambiguity.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A GitHub-native service-side object retained/discoverable across history rollback with documented monotonic freshness semantics and atomic or deterministically reconcilable coupling to repository publication.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only retrieved official GitHub commit-status, Git commit lookup, and Enterprise Server unreachable-object documentation plus a bounded dual-write trace model; GitHub.com unreachable-status retention was not experimentally generalized.
